FIELDS.NAME: Bargain Bazaar
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bargain Bazaar operates as a retail store located at 123 Bargain Blvd, Springfield, IL, specializing in a wide range of new consumer goods including household items, clothing, toys, and personal care products. Our core operations focus on providing an engaging shopping experience for customers in-store, with all products vetted for quality and safety. We maintain strong inventory management and loss prevention controls to minimize shrinkage, offering regular inventory audits and staff training to enhance our service and security. With a limited online presence, our sales are predominantly derived from physical retail, ensuring we meet compliance standards and maintain a secure environment for our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on March 5, 2023, due to shoplifting, totaling $1,000. The claim is currently closed. An additional loss on June 10, 2023, resulted from a broken water pipe causing property damage assessed at $1,500. This claim is still under review.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-resistant safe, UL-rated Class 350, with 1-hour fire protection, suitable for securing cash and important documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours, monitored surveillance cameras, and alarm systems for theft prevention.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The operations at Bargain Bazaar do not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. The focus is primarily on retailing new consumer goods with no engagement in activities related to hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Bargain Bazaar does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its business operations, focusing primarily on retailing consumer goods.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking and verifying these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There has been no indictment or conviction for fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crime concerning this or any other property associated with the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Bargain Bazaar has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We have maintained consistent coverage with our previous carrier, Lakeside Insurance Group.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Bargain Bazaar does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed by the store.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Bargain Bazaar does not currently carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as all employees are directly managed and no leasing of workers occurs.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Bargain Bazaar does not own or operate any other business; it solely focuses on retailing a wide range of consumer goods at its location.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Bargain Bazaar currently does not hold any other insurance policies with this company. The only policy in effect is for the current year, and no prior policies are listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Bargain Bazaar is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on retailing pre-vetted new consumer goods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Bargain Bazaar does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus exclusively on retailing consumer goods.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Bargain Bazaar has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial status with no significant credit issues reported.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Bargain Bazaar does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as its operations focus solely on retailing new consumer goods that do not involve hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Bargain Bazaar has no known catastrophe exposure, as the business operates solely in retailing new consumer goods and does not engage in activities that would typically introduce such risks. The operations prioritize safety and quality without exposure to high-risk environments.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Bargain Bazaar has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains strict hiring practices and compliance with applicable regulations to ensure a safe environment for employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Bargain Bazaar does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety regulations. The store maintains a commitment to fire safety and code adherence.
